title: CTOs Agree: Cognitive Debt Is the New Technical Debt
summary: This article explores the emerging concept of 'cognitive debt' - the mental overhead and decision complexity that accumulates in software projects over time - which CTOs are increasingly recognizing as a significant challenge alongside traditional technical debt. The piece discusses how accumulated knowledge complexity, unclear architectural decisions, and implicit team knowledge create friction that slows developer productivity.
problem_solved: Addresses the accumulation of mental complexity and implicit knowledge overhead that slows down engineering teams, distinct from but related to traditional code-level technical debt.
why_valuable: Introduces a valuable mental model for engineering leaders to diagnose and address the invisible cognitive burdens that reduce team velocity and increase onboarding friction.
